en: Bravo! You made it all the way to me! My puzzle was no match for you.
text: Bravo! Ai ajuns până la mine! Puzzle-ul meu n-a avut nicio șansă cu tine.

en: Do you know, I stayed up all night planting those trees? And you cut through them like they were nothing!
text: Știi că am stat toată noaptea să plantez copacii aceia? Iar tu i-ai tăiat de parcă n-ar fi fost nimic!

en: A deal's a deal. You've earned this reward.
text: Promisiunea e promisiune. Ți-ai câștigat recompensa.

en: Those holes took me a week to dig! And you just pressed every button in the right order.
was: Data viitoare voi născoci ceva cu adevărat derutant. Până atunci... Rămas-bun!

en: Red doors, blue doors, open, shut... I get lost in there myself, you know!
All those boulders, shoved about like cushions! Your Pokémon are strong.
My Mechadolls asked their hardest questions, and you knew every answer!
Round and round the gates you went, and out the other side. Dizzying!
My statues danced to your switches! I never taught them that.
My finest puzzle of all, and you slid straight through it. I have nothing left to trick you with!
For my last reward, a tent for your secret base. Which colour would you like?
{player} sent the Red Tent to the decoration PC.
{player} sent the Blue Tent to the decoration PC.
Your decoration PC is full! I'll keep the tent at the front of the house until there's room.
Next time I'll come up with something truly baffling. Until then... Farewell!
